run_coin_flip_inference: run BMGInference to sample 1000 posterior draws from a Beta-Bernoulli coin flip model
test_coin_flip_inference: test the CoinFlipTest class to verify Bayesian inference on a coin flip model with Beta prior
export_model_to_dot: export a probabilistic model to DOT graph format using BMGInference to_dot method
export_model_to_cpp: export a probabilistic model to C++ graph code using BMGInference to_cpp method
export_model_to_python: export a probabilistic model to Python graph code using BMGInference to_python method
